ja336:1.1: Tiṇaṃ tiṇan ti lapasi, ko nu te tiṇam āhari, kin nu te tiṇakicc' atthi, tiṇam eva pabhāsasīti.
ja336:2.1: Idhāgamā brahmacārī brahā Chatto bahussuto, so me sabbaṃ samādāya tiṇaṃ nikkhippa gacchatīti.
ja336:3.1: Ev' etaṃ hoti kattabbaṃ appena bahum icchatā: sabbaṃ sakassa ādānaṃ anādānaṃ tiṇassa cā 'ti.
ja336:4.1: Sīlavanto na kubbanti, bālo sīlāni kubbati, aniccasīlaṃ dussīlaṃ, kiṃ paṇḍiccaṃ karissatīti.
